scenarios.scenario: Open ribbon customization from a panel

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the user right-clicks a ribbon panel title
the user chooses "Customize User Commands"
the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab
the available commands and target custom panel lists are displayed
the target tab is "Part | 3D Model"

scenarios.scenario: Stage a command in the selected custom panel

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog is open with an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model"
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands
the user clicks the right transfer button
"2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list
the target tab selector indicates a pending change
"OK", "Cancel", and "Apply" are available

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has staged "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations"
the user selects "3D Annotations" and clicks the up arrow
"3D Annotations" appears above "2D Sketches"
the user selects the "Large" checkbox for "3D Annotations"
its "Large" checkbox is checked
the user removes "3D Annotations" with the left transfer button
"3D Annotations" returns to the available commands list
"2D Sketches" remains in the custom panel list

scenarios.scenario: Cancel an uncommitted custom panel edit

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has a staged "2D Sketches" addition to the initially empty "Part | 3D Model" custom panel
the user clicks "Cancel"
the customization dialog closes
no custom panel appears in the visible ribbon
the user reopens ribbon customization
the "Part | 3D Model" custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog displays all commands
the user chooses "Sketch Tab" as the command category
the available list displays sketch commands including "Circle (Center Point)"
the selected target remains "Part | 3D Model"

scenarios.scenario: Apply and remove a custom ribbon panel

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model"
the command category is "Sketch Tab"
the user adds "Circle (Center Point)" and a separator to the custom panel list
the custom panel list contains the circle command followed by a separator
the separator remains available in the source list
the user clicks "Apply"
the customization dialog remains open
the target selector no longer indicates a pending change
the "User Commands" panel appears on the active ribbon
the user removes the separator and the circle command from the custom panel list
the user clicks "Apply"
the custom panel list is empty
the "User Commands" panel is no longer visible on the active ribbon

scenarios.scenario: Switch targets while an edit is pending

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has empty custom panel lists for "Part | Sketch" and "Part | Annotate"
the user selects "Part | Sketch" as the target
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list
the user selects "Part | Annotate" as the target
the custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user returns to the "Part | Sketch" target
"2D Sketches" is still in its custom panel list
the target selector indicates a pending change
the user clicks "Cancel"
the customization dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Change the display of an applied custom command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model"
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list
the user selects "Text" and leaves "Large" clear for the command
the user clicks "Apply"
the "User Commands" panel shows a small command icon with "2D Sketches" beside it
the user selects "Large" for the same command
the user clicks "Apply"
the panel shows a larger command icon with "2D Sketches" beneath it
the customization dialog remains open

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the user clicks "<action>"
a "<title>" file dialog opens
the file type is "XML Files (*.xml)"
the dialog offers "<confirm>" and "Cancel"
the user clicks "Cancel"
the file dialog closes
the ribbon customization dialog remains open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenarios.scenario: Export customization settings to a new XML file

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a new XML file path is available in a writable directory
the user clicks "Export"

the user clicks "Save"
the export dialog closes
the ribbon customization dialog remains open
a non-empty valid XML file exists at the chosen path
